title: Catalan Kabocha Wrap
description: A delicious and nutritious wrap filled with roasted kabocha squash and topped with a tangy Catalan-inspired sauce.
instructions: Cut the kabocha squash in half and scoop out the seeds.
Place the squash on a baking sheet, cut side up.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with Catalan seasoning, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Roast the squash in the preheated oven for 30-40 minutes, or until tender.
While the squash is roasting, prepare the Catalan-inspired sauce by whisking together lemon juice and olive oil in a small bowl.
Once the squash is done, let it cool for a few minutes before scooping it out of its skin and into a bowl.
Add the Catalan-inspired sauce to the bowl with the squash and toss to combine.
Warm the Catalan wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the squash mixture onto the wrap and top with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
